issues.legal_issue: A creditor’s claim based on an arbitral award under appeal may not be admitted after the committee of creditors has approved the resolution plan where the creditor’s substantial delay is not justified.
Public announcement of the corporate insolvency resolution process in accordance with the statutory requirements constitutes deemed knowledge of the process for a commercial creditor.

The fact that the adjudicating authority has not yet approved a resolution plan does not permit the insolvency resolution process to be reopened to admit belated claims after the committee of creditors has approved the plan.
